paragraphs: Rubin. Yerushalmi Hallah quotes R' Yohanan: ‘The rubin came and abolished tithes.’ In the checked passage he mentions both heave-offerings and tithes, and the next line identifies the rubin as targemonayya. Rosh, Avodah Zarah, R' Yishmael, explains this of the sages of Israel; alternatively, of those who instituted tithes and abolished our tithes. I say: perhaps these are R' Hiyya's sons, who are mentioned as rubin in the first chapter of Hullin.
